name: Nan Pao Resins Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Nan Pao Resins Chemical Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacturing, wholesale, and retail sale of synthetic resins and plastics, adhesives, resin coatings, dyes, and pigments in Taiwan, rest of Asia, Oceania, Europe, Africa, and America.
